sections.title: Finding a song
items: The search bar at the top of the screen searches by title or artist and takes you straight to the filtered repertoire.
In "Repertoire", refine with filters: artist, category, language, key, difficulty, year, presence of chords or video.
"Explore" offers an overview by new additions, artists and categories.

sections.title: Editing a song
items: From a song's page, the "Edit" button opens the section-and-measure editor.
Keyboard shortcuts in the editor: Ctrl/Cmd+Z (undo), Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z (redo), Ctrl/Cmd+D (duplicate the selected section), Delete (clear the selected measure).
Saving happens automatically — the status is shown at the top of the editor.

sections.title: Assignments and tracking
items: A choir director assigns a section, a measure or an entire song to a member or a group from the "Assignments" tab of the song page.
Each member tracks their tasks in "My space" (dashboard), with a status of to-do / in progress / done / to review.
Learning mode guides a member through their assigned part, along with the director's comments.

sections.title: Rehearsal modes
items: Rehearsal mode: navigate measure by measure with optional auto-playback.
Presentation mode: full screen, large text, designed to be projected during a rehearsal or a service.
